title: Typed Agent Result + Explicit Gate Engine

acceptance_gates.gate_1_invalid_schema_cannot_succeed: VERIFIED (Unparseable responses or schema-invalid JSON payloads fail closed with SchemaValidationGateError)
acceptance_gates.gate_2_missing_required_evidence_refs_ca: VERIFIED (Hallucinated or ungrounded evidence/artifact references fail closed with EvidenceRefGateError)
acceptance_gates.gate_3_gate_results_are_individually_vis: VERIFIED (AgentResultGateEvaluation provides granular, inspectable check details and scores for each gate)
acceptance_gates.gate_4_agent_done_text_never_equals_comp: VERIFIED (Unstructured narrative completion claims raise AgentCompletionClaimRejectedError)
acceptance_gates.gate_5_handoff_validator_interoperabilit: VERIFIED (TypedAgentResult.to_handoff_payload produces bilateral handoff records validated by HandoffValidator)

false_proof_defenses.defense_1_arbitrary_json_wrong_schema: BLOCKED (Arbitrary valid JSON fails schema_conformance and required_fields checks)
false_proof_defenses.defense_2_fake_artifact_references: BLOCKED (Fake/ungrounded artifact IDs fail evidence_refs_verifiable check)
false_proof_defenses.defense_3_plausible_narrative_missing_fi: BLOCKED (Long explanatory narratives lacking contract keys fail required_fields check)
false_proof_defenses.defense_4_authority_lane_mutation_attemp: BLOCKED (Read-only lane agents proposing SQL database mutations fail authority_lane_parity check)

concrete_trace_demonstrated.pipeline_path: AgentDefinition -> AgentInvocation -> Model Inference -> AgentResultGateEngine -> TypedAgentResult -> HandoffValidator

limitations: Bounded Repair Same-Session Retry loops will be implemented in Mandate M55
